ideas.what: Write four rule corrections into CONTEXT.md BEFORE K2 scores (~07:00-08:00 UTC) and before the exp60 results arrive. (1) Reclassify C05 lowrefine and C04 forkmid out of R3's 'nodes unchanged / coordinates only' class. They change nodes or forks, so they get their own rule: compare with the scored twin (K2 vs K1; K3 vs K2). Adopt if >= twin (a tie counts in favour, as R2 does for insertion). Drop at -0.001 or worse. Never keep a rider at -0.001 'because the lab passed'. (2) Delete §f fallback item 4 (#34), because it contradicts 'never tick exp56'. The fallback becomes K-previous -> K1 -> exp52. (3) Settle NOW which reading of the DeepCenter plateau rule applies: tools/trainlab.py gates() reports both pass_strict and pass_noncontrol_plateau and says 'the main session decides'. Recommended reading: noncontrol, because under the strict reading a neighbour equal to the 0.25 control has delta 0 by definition. (4) State that R5(b) (step-0 forecast 7.8 h vs 9.5 h, a 1.7 h margin) admits K2 even if the overnight poller fails. Only the question 'did the 8.0 h insertion gate fire?' needs a COMPLETE seen <= 08:01 UTC, so keep the poller alive for 07:00-08:30 UTC.
ideas.why_now: The K2 dummy shows that lowrefine is not a coordinate-only rider. It adds readmits (1,365 vs 1,337, +2.1%), +33 final nodes, +29 edges and +1 fork. It also moves the safe-division geometric candidates (155 -> 141 on 44b6_0b24845f, 222 -> 230 on 6bba_05db0fb1). Under R3 as written, a K2 showing 0.953 would stay in F1. Given the rounding (#35's true value sits somewhere in a 0.001 bin), that happens with P ~0.12 even though lowrefine's expected effect is only about +0.0002. The DC plateau choice, if made after seeing the lab numbers, is a forking path of exactly the kind R9 forbids on the LB.

ideas.what: (a) Add a timing gate to tools/dummy_gates.py for every rider build (K3/K3b/K4/RE-AIM/F1-final). Compare the per-dataset '[ds] detection+edges X s' and '[ds] repair X s' lines of the rider dummy with the K2 dummy; do not use the whole-kernel time, because shard launch jitters from 258 s to ~700 s. FAIL if the tail grows by > 8 s/clip or the GPU phase by > 15 s/clip-shard. A build that fails it must be rebuilt with DIVINS_DEADLINE_S raised to 32,400 (9.0 h; REPAIR_DEADLINE_S stays 34,200). (b) Record in CONTEXT that the FD dummy scores HIGHER than full x138 locally and that this must not be acted on. FD = degraded tail with no relink, readmit or gapfill: 0.9249 vs 0.9180, 44b6_0113de3b 0.868 -> 0.961. This is the 'trust the in-sample ILP over relink' pattern that gave +0.016 locally and 0 on LB (#29/#30).
ideas.why_now: Step-0 worst case for K2: T = 300 + (97/2)*318 + 97*127.3 s = 28,071 s = 7.80 h. The last clip's insertion therefore starts about 830 s before the 8.0 h DIVINS gate. A rider that adds ~9 s/clip of tail (e.g. a lower DeepCenter threshold with more safe-division candidates; insertion costs ~2.3 ms per detection) or ~17 s/clip-shard of GPU (tempfuse) silently turns the insertion off on the alphabetically last clips. Those clips are a mix of public and private, so the LB barely sees it, and the rider is then credited or blamed wrongly. Time gates also make outputs depend on runtime, so twin comparisons (K2 vs K1, K3 vs K2) are clean only when neither gate fired. A latency of <= 8.0 h proves that.
ideas.evidence: experiments/runtime_step0/step0.md (model and N <= 97-106); dummy logs in _dl/: K2 repair 81.7 + 119.9 + 20.4 + 287.2 = 509 s vs exp56 226.5 s; insertion +178 s on 6bba_05db0fb1 (76,396 detections); detection+edges 213.6 s (K2) vs 215.2 s (K1), so lowrefine's GPU cost is ~0. ideas.expected_gain: Protects the +0.001 insertion gain on late clips for every later build. Guess: it avoids a silent -0.0002 to -0.0005 in the ~10-20% of worlds where a heavier rider plus a slower host crosses 8.0 h. (b) prevents a false lead.

plan_critique: Under the red-team lens with the 25 Sep facts: (1) FALLBACK HOLE. Branch A holds K1, #35 is inadmissible under R5 (L35 in (6.72, 7.73] h), and §f's fallback item 4 (#34) contradicts 'never tick exp56'. So a K2 error drops F1 to exp52 (0.950), and a K2 showing 0.953 stays in F1 because R3 tolerates -0.001. Fix: submit K1 in S3 tonight (RT1) and delete item 4. (2) R3 MISCLASSIFIES C05 and C04. The K2 dummy shows lowrefine changes readmits (+2.1%), nodes (+33), edges (+29) and forks (+1), and moves the safe-division candidates (155->141, 222->230). Judge riders against their scored twin; a tie keeps the rider, -0.001 drops it (RT2). (3) THE exp60 LAB BASE IS NOT THE K STACK: no lowrefine in kernel_a/b. The DC plateau reading is left to be chosen after the results. Both need fixing before the numbers land (RT2, RT3). The lab is in-sample for the detector and edge net (pilkwang trained on all 199), so it can only veto, never promote. Locally the FD dummy even beats full x138 by +0.007, the same in-sample trap as the edge filter (RT4b). (4) The THIN MARGIN is the 8.0 h insertion gate, not the 12 h limit or the 9.5 h deadline: the K2 worst case is 7.80 h, about 830 s before the gate. Any rider with more runtime (tempfuse, a lower DC threshold) needs a timing gate or a 9.0 h DIVINS deadline (RT4). The '~4 h unused headroom' belongs to the 12 h limit, not to the insertion gate. (5) The F2 rationale partly lapses. The hidden rerun scores public and private in ONE run, and K builds have C01, so 'exp52 insures against the timer firing on private' is worth ~0 once K2's latency is seen <= 8 h. exp52 stays justified only as private-transfer diversity. With a public gap of -0.004 and a private difference sd ~0.003, E[(exp52-F1)+] is ~+0.0001. That is still positive and comparable to a same-family variant (~+0.0001), so the default can stay, but the reason should be restated. (6) Riders below LB resolution: forkmid (+0.0003..0.0008) and the DC threshold (centre +0.0005) move the displayed score with P ~|delta|/0.001, so their LB 'verdicts' are mostly rounding. R4's +0.002 bar means they can almost never enter F1. Expect K3/K3b to end as 'F2 candidate or closed', and do not spend 27 Sep slots re-testing them. (7) Operations. Quota was 21:13/30 h at ~18:10 UTC. It rose only 2 h 17 m since 13:58 while hidden reruns ran, which is consistent with 'reruns are free'. That is enough for exp60 shard B before the Saturday 00:00 UTC reset, and it should be re-checked after the reset. Keep the poller alive 07:00-08:30 UTC 26 Sep: R5(b) already admits K2 without it, but only a COMPLETE seen by 08:01 UTC proves the insertion gate did not fire. Submit with pinned -v 1 and check today's count first. (8) What if K2 < 0.954: with RT1 in place, F1 = K1 when K1 >= #35 and K2 = K1 - 0.001. If K1 also shows 0.953, then #35 was degraded or noise pushed it up, so re-read step 0 and consider N1 per R6. Without RT1, this world costs a full day.
